formulas.universal_action_score: relevant_skill_or_method_mastery + primary_attribute_support + floor(secondary_attribute_support/2) + equipment + preparation + position + team - fatigue - injury - external_load - disruption - environment

rule: Use a subsystem-specific resolver whenever one exists. The universal action score is only the registered fallback for actions without a more specific mechanical kernel. Capability bands describe comparative rarity, not institutional rank. Values at or above 170 are exceptional and must not be manufactured by routine training.
